assumptions: The dimension is positive; A is nonsingular; b is nonzero; xExact solves A*xExact=b; and Ainv has both inverse actions, so kappa_F(A)=||Ainv||_F*||A||_F uses the actual inverse.
The high- and low-precision unit roundoffs are nonnegative families tending to zero, with uHigh <= uLow and valid gamma_n^high.
At every restart, the computed residual and update satisfy the exact high-precision equations (6.19) and (6.20), including their componentwise error bounds.

Every correction is produced by a fully stored low-precision MGS-Arnoldi restart with a positive restart-dependent key dimension k_i <= n, an explicit residual cast, Arnoldi product, perturbed least-squares solve, and rounded correction formation.

The low-precision restart records witness forms of conditions (3.5)-(3.8) and the correction-level backward and forward certificates supplied by the Section 5.3 MGS-GMRES analysis; it does not assume a recurrence for either global error.
A nonnegative bivariate polynomial records the otherwise unspecified low-degree c(n,k), and its value at (n,n) uniformly dominates all c(n,k_i).
Lambda=c(n,n)*uLow*kappa_F(A) tends to zero and is eventually a nonnegative strict contraction, which is the formal interpretation of equation (6.17)'s Lambda << 1.
The first-order iterate comparisons required by Theorem 4.1 are recorded explicitly because Theorem 6.3 invokes that theorem without separately discussing this inherited premise.
The exact-real standard model excludes underflow, overflow, NaNs, and infinities; all lesssim relations retain an O((uHigh+uLow)^2) remainder.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p16_t3_mixed_precision_geometric_convergence {n : Nat} {iota : Type*} {l : Filter iota} [l.NeBot] (run : P16MixedPrecisionGMRESRun l) (hLambda : p16MuchLessThanOneAt l (p16MixedContraction run)) : (forall i, p16FirstOrderLeAt l (p16MixedScale run) (actualBackwardError_(i+1)) (Lambda*actualBackwardError_i + backwardFloor)) and (forall i, p16FirstOrderLeAt l (p16MixedScale run) (actualForwardError_(i+1)) (Lambda*actualForwardError_i + forwardFloor))
formal_statement.plain_language: For every restart of the recorded mixed-precision MGS-GMRES execution, the actual normalized backward error and relative forward error contract by the uniform low-precision factor Lambda up to their respective high-precision first-order floors.

informal_proof: Use the high-precision residual and update equations to decompose the next true residual and next solution error into the low-precision correction defect plus high-precision residual/update errors. Apply Euclidean triangle inequalities, normalize by the paper's exact backward- and forward-error denominators, use the Section 5.3 correction certificates, dominate each restart factor c(n,k_i)*uLow*kappa_F(A) by the uniform Lambda, and combine the retained second-order remainders.
informal_statement: Theorem 6.3's per-restart first-order contraction for actual mixed-precision restarted MGS-GMRES errors, with Lambda=c(n,k)uLow*kappa_F(A), backward floor c(n,k)uHigh, and forward floor c(n,k)uHigh*kappa_F(A).

tier_rationale: The mounted condition-L library supplies only generic Euclidean and Frobenius norm facts useful in the composition proof. It contains no MGS-Arnoldi execution model, restart-dependent key-dimension framework, mixed-precision operation linkage, actual GMRES error definitions, or Theorem 6.3 contraction theorem. Both conditions must construct the paper-specific execution and combine its correction and high-precision error certificates, so the selected result remains an extension task.
